::: {.store-lede}
One line per team per game: result, points by quarter, total, passing and rushing yards, plays, first downs, third- and fourth-down conversions, turnovers, sacks, penalties, scoring by type, time of possession, rest days, conditions, head coach and starting quarterback. Regular season and playoffs are in the same file, told apart by season_type and game_type; the preseason is not included. Totals are added up from the play-by-play, so a team's yardage can differ from the official box score by a few yards in a small share of games, most often on plays with laterals or fumbles; games are listed once they have been played.
:::

## Columns

One row per team per game. 62 columns. A row is identified by `game_id` + `team`.

```{=html}
<div class="store-dict"><table class="table">
<thead><tr>
<th>Column</th>
<th>Type</th>
<th>What it holds</th>
</tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td>game_id</td><td>string</td><td>nflverse game id: season, week, away team and home team (2023_01_DET_KC); joins every NFL file.</td></tr>
<tr><td>season</td><td>int</td><td>NFL season, named for the year it starts (the 2023 season ends with the February 2024 Super Bowl).</td></tr>
<tr><td>season_type</td><td>string</td><td>REG for the regular season, POST for the playoffs.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_type</td><td>string</td><td>Round of the season: REG (regular season), WC (wild card), DIV (divisional), CON (conference championship), SB (Super Bowl).</td></tr>
<tr><td>week</td><td>int</td><td>Week of the season; playoff weeks continue the count after the last regular-season week.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_date</td><td>date</td><td>Date of the game in US Eastern time.</td></tr>
<tr><td>team</td><td>string</td><td>Team abbreviation; one code per franchise in every season (LV, LAC and LA also cover the Oakland, San Diego and St. Louis years).</td></tr>
<tr><td>opponent</td><td>string</td><td>Opponent&#x27;s abbreviation; its row for the same game_id holds what this team allowed.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_away</td><td>string</td><td>home or away; at a neutral site this is the designated side.</td></tr>
<tr><td>neutral_site</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the game was played at a neutral site.</td></tr>
<tr><td>result</td><td>string</td><td>W, L or T.</td></tr>
<tr><td>points_for</td><td>int</td><td>Final points scored by the team, overtime included.</td></tr>
<tr><td>points_against</td><td>int</td><td>Final points scored by the opponent, overtime included.</td></tr>
<tr><td>points_q1</td><td>int</td><td>Points scored in the first quarter.</td></tr>
<tr><td>points_q2</td><td>int</td><td>Points scored in the second quarter.</td></tr>
<tr><td>points_q3</td><td>int</td><td>Points scored in the third quarter.</td></tr>
<tr><td>points_q4</td><td>int</td><td>Points scored in the fourth quarter.</td></tr>
<tr><td>points_ot</td><td>int</td><td>Points scored in overtime; 0 when there was none.</td></tr>
<tr><td>overtime</td><td>bool</td><td>True if the game went to overtime.</td></tr>
<tr><td>total_yards</td><td>int</td><td>Net yards of offense: net passing yards plus rushing yards.</td></tr>
<tr><td>passing_yards</td><td>int</td><td>Net passing yards: gross passing yards minus yards lost on sacks, the way team passing is listed in a box score.</td></tr>
<tr><td>rushing_yards</td><td>int</td><td>Rushing yards, kneel-downs and yards after laterals on runs included.</td></tr>
<tr><td>offensive_plays</td><td>int</td><td>Offensive plays: pass attempts plus sacks plus rushing attempts.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pass_attempts</td><td>int</td><td>Pass attempts: completions, incompletions and interceptions, spikes included, sacks excluded.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pass_completions</td><td>int</td><td>Completed passes.</td></tr>
<tr><td>gross_passing_yards</td><td>int</td><td>Passing yards before sack yardage is taken off; the sum of the team&#x27;s player passing yards.</td></tr>
<tr><td>passing_tds</td><td>int</td><td>Touchdown passes.</td></tr>
<tr><td>interceptions_thrown</td><td>int</td><td>Passes intercepted by the opponent.</td></tr>
<tr><td>sacks_taken</td><td>int</td><td>Times the team&#x27;s quarterbacks were sacked.</td></tr>
<tr><td>sack_yards_lost</td><td>int</td><td>Yards lost on those sacks.</td></tr>
<tr><td>rush_attempts</td><td>int</td><td>Rushing attempts, scrambles and kneel-downs included.</td></tr>
<tr><td>rushing_tds</td><td>int</td><td>Rushing touchdowns.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_downs</td><td>int</td><td>First downs gained, by rush, pass or penalty.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_downs_rushing</td><td>int</td><td>First downs gained by rushing.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_downs_passing</td><td>int</td><td>First downs gained by passing.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_downs_penalty</td><td>int</td><td>First downs awarded by penalty.</td></tr>
<tr><td>third_down_attempts</td><td>int</td><td>Third downs that ended in a conversion or a stop.</td></tr>
<tr><td>third_down_conversions</td><td>int</td><td>Third downs converted.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fourth_down_attempts</td><td>int</td><td>Fourth-down tries: plays the offense ran on fourth down to gain the first down.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fourth_down_conversions</td><td>int</td><td>Fourth downs converted.</td></tr>
<tr><td>turnovers</td><td>int</td><td>Giveaways: interceptions thrown plus fumbles lost.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fumbles_lost</td><td>int</td><td>Fumbles lost to the opponent on any play, returns and kicks included.</td></tr>
<tr><td>penalties</td><td>int</td><td>Plays with an accepted penalty against the team; when two fouls are enforced on one play it counts once, so this can run one short of the box score.</td></tr>
<tr><td>penalty_yards</td><td>int</td><td>Yards assessed on those penalties.</td></tr>
<tr><td>touchdowns</td><td>int</td><td>Touchdowns scored by the team on offense, defense and special teams.</td></tr>
<tr><td>field_goals_made</td><td>int</td><td>Field goals made.</td></tr>
<tr><td>field_goal_attempts</td><td>int</td><td>Field goals attempted, blocked kicks included.</td></tr>
<tr><td>extra_points_made</td><td>int</td><td>Extra-point kicks made.</td></tr>
<tr><td>extra_point_attempts</td><td>int</td><td>Extra-point kicks attempted.</td></tr>
<tr><td>two_point_conversions</td><td>int</td><td>Two-point tries converted by the offense.</td></tr>
<tr><td>defensive_two_point_conversions</td><td>int</td><td>Two-point scores by the defense: an opponent&#x27;s extra point or two-point try returned to the other end zone.</td></tr>
<tr><td>safeties</td><td>int</td><td>Safeties scored by the team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>punts</td><td>int</td><td>Punts, blocked punts included.</td></tr>
<tr><td>time_of_possession_seconds</td><td>int</td><td>Time of possession in seconds, summed from the NFL&#x27;s drive summary; blank in the one to three games a season where that summary does not add up to the length of the game.</td></tr>
<tr><td>rest_days</td><td>int</td><td>Days since the team&#x27;s previous game; 7 for a season opener.</td></tr>
<tr><td>roof</td><td>string</td><td>Stadium roof: outdoors, dome, or closed / open for a retractable roof.</td></tr>
<tr><td>surface</td><td>string</td><td>Playing surface, such as grass or fieldturf.</td></tr>
<tr><td>temperature_f</td><td>int</td><td>Temperature at kickoff in degrees Fahrenheit; blank for domes and closed roofs.</td></tr>
<tr><td>wind_mph</td><td>int</td><td>Wind speed at kickoff in miles per hour; blank for domes and closed roofs.</td></tr>
<tr><td>head_coach</td><td>string</td><td>The team&#x27;s head coach for the game.</td></tr>
<tr><td>starting_qb_id</td><td>string</td><td>Player id (NFL GSIS id) of the team&#x27;s starting quarterback.</td></tr>
<tr><td>starting_qb_name</td><td>string</td><td>The team&#x27;s starting quarterback.</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>
```

## Source and method

Source: nflverse (github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data), released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license, CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0): play-by-play from nflfastR, games and schedules as maintained by Lee Sharpe. Changes: columns were selected and renamed, a few repeated plays removed, and the game logs added up from the play-by-play.

The same file layout, IDs and column names are used for every season, so seasons stack without cleanup. See [how the store works](help.qmd) for formats, delivery and the license.

## More NFL data

[Player Game Logs](nfl-player-logs.qmd) · [Play-by-Play](nfl-play-by-play.qmd) · [Games and Results](nfl-schedule.qmd) · [All NFL data](nfl.qmd)

::: {.faq-item}
### How do the NFL files join to each other?

On the ID columns. Game, team and player IDs are the same strings in every NFL file and every season, so a join on `game_id` (plus `team` or `player_id` where the grain needs it) lines them up.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### Which games are included?

Every regular-season and playoff game, built from the open nflverse play-by-play. Regular season and postseason sit in the same file, told apart by `season_type`. Preseason and All-Star games are left out.
:::
